product.title: Professional Stargazing in Joshua Tree

description.text: Spend a relaxed evening under Joshua Tree’s famously dark desert skies with a small-group stargazing experience led by an astronomy guide. After meeting your host, head to a low-light viewing area where the night opens up with bright constellations and seasonal celestial targets. You’ll use professional telescopes to observe planets, star clusters, nebulae, and other deep-sky objects based on visibility and time of year, while your guide explains what you’re seeing in simple, engaging terms. The pace is unhurried, with time to ask questions, settle into the quiet atmosphere, and enjoy the vast desert horizon after sunset. It’s an approachable way to experience the park at night, whether you’re brand-new to astronomy or already love looking up.

highlights: Small-group stargazing in Joshua Tree with a professional guide
Telescope viewing of seasonal planets, constellations, and deep-sky objects
Learn basic astronomy and night-sky orientation in plain language
Experience calm desert conditions away from city light pollution
